Only company self-declaration available: lamtuf.com Investors Relations page states "Today, Lamtuf is the largest exporter of industrial laminates from India" and "Lamtuf has witnessed a dramatic increase in supply to distribution transformers, loco transformers, and other electrical equipment manufacturers in recent times" — this is a website claim, not a verified domestic supply record. The site does list an Annual Reports section and DRHP, but the annual-report PDFs were not fetched within the call budget, so no revenue split was extracted.
note: Manufacturer (own integrated plant: resin making, impregnation, pressing, machining; ISO 9001/14001/45001), not a trader. Export activity is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L rows with HS codes and B-L numbers, destinations UAE and USA, plus large repeat buyer aggregates to Atlas Fibre LLC (USA) and DC Wort Composites (South Africa). Declared HS 392190 is broadly consistent with the actual product mix, but observed export HS codes are 70199000 (glass polyester/FRP sheet) and 39269099 (industrial laminates) — the factual codes should be recorded as 70199000 / 39269099 alongside 392190; per project rules this is not a rejection ground. Domestic supply: declared only, no GST turnover band, tender or contract evidence obtained — search tooling was unavailable, so this is 'not verified', not 'no supplies'.
